semiconductor_relevance: High — Semishare Co., Ltd specializes in wafer probing and semiconductor test technology solutions, serving a wide range of clients in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Semishare Co., Ltd provides high-performance wafer probers and semiconductor test technology solutions, catering to over 1,000 universities, research institutes, and manufacturing facilities globally. Their product offerings include various types of probers and laser repair machines designed for both research and mass production environments.
capabilities: Semi-automatic and fully automatic mass production probers

regional_presence.China: As one of China's leading semiconductor test equipment providers, Semishare has established a strong presence in the domestic market.
